adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. Because of optional chaining, when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null` this becomes a silent no-op, so `teamDestinationCalendars` gathered from other hosts are not added to the event. This is a real behavior defect visible in the diff: the code intends to add team members’ destination calendars, but fails when the organizer/event type lacks one.
